# Eugenia Gorbacheva

> A watercolor artist's portfolio showcasing original paintings and fine art giclee prints across botanical, landscape, cityscape, seascape, and animal subjects.

Eugenia Gorbacheva is an accomplished watercolor painter specializing in Mediterranean and European scenes, offering both original one-of-a-kind paintings and museum-quality giclee prints. The site features curated collections organized by subject matter, an instructional book on water landscape techniques, and artist biography.

## Key Topics

- Watercolor paintings
- Original artwork
- Giclee prints
- Mediterranean art
- Cityscape paintings
- Landscape art
- Botanical watercolor
- Seascape art

- Fine art prints
- Wall decor

- Home decoration
- Gift ideas
- Watercolor techniques

## Featured Collections

- [Original Watercolor Paintings & Giclee Prints](https://eugeniagorbacheva.com): Homepage featuring paintings, prints, and lessons from watercolor artist Eugenia Gorbacheva
- [Watercolour Paintings (Original)](https://eugeniagorbacheva.com/collections/original-paintings): Gallery of original one-of-a-kind watercolor paintings across all themes
- [Fine Art Giclee Prints](https://eugeniagorbacheva.com/collections/fine-art-giclee-prints): Museum-quality archival giclee prints on paper and canvas

## Art Collections by Subject

- [Landscape Paintings](https://eugeniagorbacheva.com/collections/landscape-paintings): Original landscape watercolor paintings including Nordic and Aurora Borealis scenes
- [Landscape Art Prints](https://eugeniagorbacheva.com/collections/landscape-art-prints): Landscape art prints showcasing mountains, nature, and contemporary wall art
- [Cityscape Paintings](https://eugeniagorbacheva.com/collections/cityscape-paintings): Original watercolor cityscape paintings featuring Paris and European cities
- [City Art Prints](https://eugeniagorbacheva.com/collections/city-art-prints): Cityscape art prints featuring European cities like Prague and Greece
- [Coastal & Sea Paintings](https://eugeniagorbacheva.com/collections/coastal-sea-paintings): Original watercolor paintings of Mediterranean coastal and sea scenes
- [Seascape Art Prints](https://eugeniagorbacheva.com/collections/seascape-art-prints): Giclee seascape prints capturing coastal beauty and ocean scenes
- [Flower & Plant Paintings](https://eugeniagorbacheva.com/collections/flower-plant-paintings): Original watercolor paintings featuring flowers, plants, and botanical subjects
- [Botanical Art Prints](https://eugeniagorbacheva.com/collections/botanical-art-prints): Fine art prints of botanical watercolor works including floral designs
- [Animal & Birds Paintings](https://eugeniagorbacheva.com/collections/animal-birds-paintings): Original watercolor paintings of animals, birds, and wildlife subjects
- [Animal & Bird Art Prints](https://eugeniagorbacheva.com/collections/animal-bird-art-prints): Collection of giclee prints featuring animal and bird watercolor artwork
